description: This file contains unit tests for the OutboundMappingProcessor class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies the behavior of message processing, mapping, grouping, enrichment, acknowledgment handling, and error cases for outbound messaging in the project.

classes.name: OutboundMappingProcessorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the OutboundMappingProcessor's message processing and mapping logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up class-wide resources before all tests run.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down resources after all tests have run.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageMapped
methods.description: Tests that a message is correctly mapped and sent out.

methods.name: testOutboundResponseMapped
methods.description: Tests mapping of outbound response messages.

methods.name: testGroupingOfTargets
methods.description: Verifies message grouping logic based on multiple targets.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageEnriched
methods.description: Tests if outbound messages are enriched with extra data.

methods.name: testOutboundEventWithRequestedAcksWhichAreIssuedByTargetDontContainRequestedAcks
methods.description: Verifies acknowledgment headers when targets issue acknowledgments different from what was requested.

methods.name: testOutboundLiveMessageWithRequestedAcksWhichAreIssuedByTargetDontContainRequestedAcks
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment handling for live messages with different acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageDropped
methods.description: Ensures messages be dropped when specified.

methods.name: testOutboundMappingFails
methods.description: Tests the behavior when message mapping fails.

methods.name: testOutboundMessageDroppedFailedMappedDuplicated
methods.description: Checks combined behavior for drop, mapping failure, and duplication.

methods.name: targetWithMapping
methods.description: Helper method to create target with specified mappings.

methods.name: testOutbound
methods.description: Helper method to run outbound message tests with different parameters.
